issues.concern: The gloss includes 'kettle', which is misleading as 釜 (kama) does not typically refer to a kettle for boiling water.
The gloss for sense 2 includes 'boiler', which is misleading. While 釜 can be part of words like 蒸気釜 (steam boiler), it doesn't mean 'boiler' on its own.
issues.suggestion: Remove 'boiler' from the gloss for sense 2.
